description: Demo accounts and incidents around Colombo, loaded by `npm run db:seed -- --demo`. All demo accounts share the password in DEMO_USER_PASSWORD.

incidents.title: Two-car collision at Kollupitiya junction
incidents.description: Two cars collided at the junction. One driver looks injured and traffic is backing up towards Kollupitiya.

incidents.title: Flooded lane on Havelock Road
incidents.description: Heavy rain has flooded the left lane near the canal. Water is about 30 cm deep and small vehicles are stalling.

incidents.title: Fallen tree blocking D. S. Senanayake Mawatha
incidents.description: A large tree has fallen across both lanes after the storm. Nobody is hurt but the road is completely blocked.

incidents.title: Broken-down bus on the Rajagiriya flyover
incidents.description: A bus has broken down in the middle lane of the flyover and is blocking traffic in both directions.

incidents.title: Three-wheeler fire near Pettah bus stand
incidents.description: A three-wheeler is on fire near the bus stand. Thick smoke is covering the road and people are gathering.

incidents.title: Motorcycle skid on High Level Road
incidents.description: A motorcycle skidded and the rider fell on the road. He is conscious but cannot stand up.
incidents.resolutionNotes: Rider taken to Colombo South Teaching Hospital. Motorcycle moved off the road and traffic is flowing normally.

incidents.title: Traffic lights down at Wellawatte junction
incidents.description: The traffic lights at the junction are not working and vehicles are crossing without any control.
incidents.resolutionNotes: Power supply to the signal controller restored. Lights are working again.

incidents.title: Car parked on the pavement near a school
incidents.description: Someone reported a car parked on the pavement near the school. Not an emergency.
incidents.rejectionReason: Parking offences are handled by the municipal council, not by emergency response.
